# Security metrics

<!-- Generated by scripts/release_metrics.py at each release. -->

For OpenClear 1.35.0, released 2026-10-31: part of the due-diligence pack ([third-party risk](tprm.md)). Each release's notes on GitHub carry the same figures for that release.

- **ASVS 5.0:** 215 of 242 applicable requirements met (88%), 7 partly, 5 not met, 15 the service provider's ([crosswalk](https://github.com/chaffed/OpenClear/blob/main/docs/compliance/asvs.md)).
- **Advisories fixed:** none.
- **Dependencies:** 109 pinned at runtime; their releases' median age is 51 days; 21 are over a year old; 18 have a newer release (Dependabot and the weekly lock refresh propose them; one with a known vulnerability fails the build).
- **SBOMs** (CycloneDX): [openclear-1.35.0.cdx.json](https://github.com/chaffed/OpenClear/releases/download/v1.35.0/openclear-1.35.0.cdx.json), the Python packages and vendored files; [openclear-1.35.0-image.cdx.json](https://github.com/chaffed/OpenClear/releases/download/v1.35.0/openclear-1.35.0-image.cdx.json), the built image with its system packages. Every component's license: [third-party components](https://github.com/chaffed/OpenClear/blob/main/docs/compliance/third-party.md).

Every change also passes CodeQL, Bandit, gitleaks, `pip-audit` and an OWASP ZAP baseline scan; ZAP's active scan runs weekly. How vulnerabilities are reported and how fast they're fixed: [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md).
